dataset_spec.name: uci_early_diabetes
dataset_spec.description: UCI Early stage diabetes risk prediction (520 adults, symptom predictors).
dataset_spec.setting: Adult attending Sylhet Diabetes Hospital, Bangladesh, completing a doctor-approved symptom questionnaire (Islam et al. 2020). The observations are age, sex and the presence of each reported symptom or sign.

diabetes.question: Based on these demographics and reported symptoms, does this person have diabetes?
